signals.name: GE Aerospace
signals.thesis: GE Aerospace hits an all-time high ($352.88) on +2.8% as industrials lead the rotation out of tech. BUY signal Jun 12 with RSI 69.4 still below overbought. MACD (11.0 > 8.5 signal) is strongly bullish. Price +9% above EMA50 and +19% above EMA200. The defense/aerospace leader benefits from commercial aviation recovery + military spending increases. Entry on VWAP pullback from today's ATH sprint; stop below EMA20 ($323) at 1.5× ATR.

signals.name: Freeport-McMoRan
signals.thesis: FCX at $70.15 trades near its 52-week high ($72.09) with a BUY signal since Jun 11. The world's largest publicly traded copper producer benefits directly from the AI data-center buildout (copper wiring demand) and global electrification. RSI 59.8 is healthy, MACD bullish (1.42 > 1.10). Price +9.4% above EMA50 with strong uptrend structure. Options flow shows large ITM call IV spikes. Entry near the breakout zone, stop below EMA50.

signals.name: Banco Santander
signals.thesis: Santander breaks to a new 52-week high ($13.48) at $13.38 (+1.8%) extending a relentless EU financials re-rating. BUY signal Jun 11, bullish MACD. EMA20 ($12.47) > EMA50 ($12.22) > EMA200 ($11.17) = textbook uptrend. Forward P/E ~10x remains cheap vs US peers. RSI 65.8 well below overbought. Options show bullish ITM call IV spikes. Third consecutive scan selection — consistency confirms the trend.

signals.name: Rio Tinto
signals.thesis: Rio Tinto at $105.74 sits 6% below its 52-week high ($112.58) with price above all EMAs (EMA20 $104.4, EMA50 $102.0, EMA200 $87.7). The diversified miner (iron ore, copper, aluminum, lithium) captures both AI infrastructure demand (copper) and the precious metals rally. RSI 53.6 signals early-stage momentum with plenty of room. BUY signal Jun 11. ~3.8% dividend yield. Healthy pullback entry near EMA20.

signals.name: Roblox
signals.thesis: Roblox surges +8.1% to $49.34 with a fresh BUY signal (Jun 15, yesterday). The user-generated gaming platform is rebuilding from its -67% drawdown from 52w highs. RSI 58.8 is moderate despite today's spike. Options activity is the most bullish in the scan — massive call volume spikes at strikes $48-52 (3-7× average) with IV spikes across the board. Below EMA50 ($49.14) but reclaiming it with today's move. Contrarian recovery play with smart money confirmation.

signals.name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria
signals.thesis: BBVA at $24.39 (+2.3%) rides the same EU financial re-rating as SAN but with stronger LatAm/Mexico exposure. Price above all EMAs with a BUY signal Jun 11. RSI 65.0 in the sweet spot. MACD is bullish. 7% below its 52-week high ($26.20), giving more room than SAN. Forward P/E ~9.5x. Correlation with SAN is high (0.89) — documented risk — but both are legitimate plays on the EU bank sector breakout.

signals.name: Dominion Energy
signals.thesis: Dominion Energy hits a 52-week high ($69.25) at $68.50 as utilities attract defensive rotation capital. BUY signal Jun 4 with RSI 62.1 in the healthy zone. EMA20 ($66.5) > EMA50 ($65.0) > EMA200 ($61.8) = clean uptrend. MACD (0.91 > 0.84) confirms. Dividend yield 3.9% adds carry. ATR is low (1.9%) allowing a tight stop at 1.75× ATR. Regulated utility with visible earnings — one of the few sectors where breakout plus defense coexist.

signals.name: VanEck Gold Miners ETF
signals.thesis: GDX at $87.24 (+2.3%) continues its recovery with a BUY signal Jun 12. Gold ($4,331) and silver ($70) rally provides fundamental wind. RSI 53.0 indicates early-stage reversal — this is not a crowded trade. Price above EMA20 ($84.05) and EMA200 ($84.09) but still below EMA50 ($87.91) — the EMA50 reclaim is the catalyst. ATR 4.6% = elevated, requiring a 6.9% stop. Third consecutive scan selection — the precious metals theme persists.

signals.name: Bath & Body Works
signals.thesis: Bath & Body Works explodes +8.3% to $21.07 on a massive reversal from its 52-week lows. BUY signal Jun 11. The specialty retail brand generates strong free cash flow with a 4.1% dividend yield. RSI 65.3 reflects momentum without overheating. A call volume spike at $21.50 (89.6× average!) signals institutional accumulation. Price is back at EMA50 ($18.94) after being crushed -38% from highs — this is a recovery breakout, not a crowded chase. Forward P/E 7.3x is deep value.

signals.name: Financial Select Sector SPDR
signals.thesis: XLF at $54.35 (+1.5%) approaches its 52-week high ($56.52) with financials as the session's top-performing sector. BUY signal Jun 4. RSI 71.2 is at the upper advisory limit but not yet overextended for an ETF. MACD (0.54 > 0.29) is bullish. Multiple call volume spikes at deep ITM strikes (up to 450× average at $35 strike). Financials benefit from steepening yield curve, strong bank earnings, and capital return programs. Low ATR (1.3%) allows tight positioning.
